restaurant_cancel = df.groupby('Restaurant_Name').agg(
    Total_Orders=('Order_ID', 'count'),
    Cancelled_Orders=('Order_Status', lambda x: (x == 'Cancelled').sum())
)

    restaurant_cancel['Cancelled_Orders']

).round(2)

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd

# Dashboard Summary
total_orders = len(df)
delivered = (df['Order_Status'] == 'Delivered').sum()
cancelled = (df['Order_Status'] == 'Cancelled').sum()
cancel_rate = cancelled / total_orders * 100 if total_orders else 0

print("=" * 45)
print(" ONLINE FOOD DELIVERY ANALYSIS DASHBOARD")
print("=" * 45)
print(f"Total Orders       : {total_orders:,}")
print(f"Delivered Orders   : {delivered:,}")
print(f"Cancelled Orders   : {cancelled:,}")
print(f"Cancellation Rate  : {cancel_rate:.2f}%")
print("=" * 45)

# Create Dashboard Charts
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle("Online Food Delivery Analysis Dashboard", fontsize=16)

# 1. Order Status
df['Order_Status'].value_counts().plot(
    kind='bar', ax=axes[0, 0], title='Order Status'
)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel("Status")
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel("Orders")
axes[0, 0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0)

# 2. City-wise Orders
df['City'].fillna('Unknown').value_counts().plot(
    kind='bar', ax=axes[0, 1], title='City-wise Orders'
)
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel("City")
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel("Orders")
axes[0, 1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=30)

# 3. Cuisine-wise Orders
df['Cuisine_Type'].fillna('Unknown').value_counts().plot(
    kind='bar', ax=axes[1, 0], title='Cuisine-wise Orders'
)
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel("Cuisine")
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel("Orders")
axes[1, 0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=30)

# 4. Cancellation Reasons
cancel_analysis = df.loc[
    df['Order_Status'] == 'Cancelled',
    'Cancellation_Reason'
].fillna('Unknown').value_counts()

cancel_analysis.plot(
    kind='bar', ax=axes[1, 1], title='Cancellation Reasons'
)
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel("Reason")
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel("Cancellations")
axes[1, 1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=30)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

=============================================
 ONLINE FOOD DELIVERY ANALYSIS DASHBOARD
=============================================
Total Orders       : 100,000
Delivered Orders   : 84,964
Cancelled Orders   : 15,036
Cancellation Rate  : 15.04%
=============================================
